notes: SpaceWire does not define OTP/fuse content as a protocol concept. Logical addresses, routing tables, data rates, and port settings are node / router configuration (often via RMAP through the configuration port). An implementation may back defaults with non-volatile storage, but the standard only requires they be configurable.

otp_equivalent_factory_burned_fields.note: The node's logical address (32..255); assigned, not a protocol-fixed OTP concept.
Logical-address-to-output-port map; programmed via RMAP / port-0 packets, not OTP-fixed.
The negotiated / configured 2..200+ Mbps signalling rate (default 10 Mbit/s at reset).
Whether each port is enabled and starts automatically.
